description: GeoAquaCrop preprocess assembles spatial inputs for running FAO AquaCrop across a user-selected polygon and time period. The aquacropos project documents Python modules that obtain daily AgERA5 or NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 climate, SoilGrids texture and organic matter, GGCMI crop calendars and SPAM crop areas. It reprojects and harmonises these inputs to a common grid and writes compressed NetCDF files. Native resolutions range from 250 metres for soil to half a degree for crop calendars; the default output grid is 0.05 degrees, which does not create finer source information. Geographic coverage depends on the requested area and source availability. Source code is free under Apache 2.0. Historical AgERA5 retrieval requires a separate Copernicus account and acceptance of dataset terms; source data have their own licences. No account access or retrieval was needed for this metadata review. A limitation is the documentation’s automatic climate-source selection outside its historical interval, which users must inspect for their requested years. Simulation uses include preparing crop-water and irrigation-demand scenarios for model-fao-aquacrop. No pipeline steps were executed or output grids tested.
